content: Root cause: The bug was likely caused by a merge conflict that was not properly resolved, leading to incomplete or incorrect code in the affected files. This resulted in issues with the handling of cryptographic modes and user settings related to RDH (Remote Data Handling) and RAH (Remote Authentication Handling), which are critical for the functionality of the application. The patch corrects these issues by ensuring that the correct values are set based on the user's cryptographic mode and RDH type, as well as cleaning up the formatting and structure of the code.
